labels: Odometry is ORACLE-ASSISTED (true increments plus noise, gyro bias std 0.002 rad/s, as dream/sim/g1_mobile.py).
The semantic detector is ORACLE-ASSISTED: rendered segmentation plus an ASSUMED, uncalibrated noise model (dream/sim/semantic_sensor.py); NOMINAL.
The base is the KINEMATIC SURROGATE (dream/sim/kinematic_base.py: no legged dynamics, no falls).

Room-type knowledge: ConceptNet 5.7 extract (third_party/household_knowledge) and/or the saved Qwen3-VL-4B text-only room priors (results/qwen_room_priors, elicited with a prompt that holds only the object name and the extract's place vocabulary). Both are uncalibrated association weights, not probabilities.

CAVEAT: the generator's furnishing tables and the evaluation were written by the same author, so agreement of a knowledge source with those tables can inflate its benefit; scenario D (atypical placement) and E (target absent) are the check against that.

The xl generator is a NEW ENVIRONMENT (dream/sim/home.py, generator 'xl'): 12 rooms in a 4 x 3 grid (13.0-14.5 m by 10.0-11.5 m), every room type the generator knows plus extra bedrooms and bathrooms, nominal furnishing tables and object scales, the nominal doorway logic.
Requests are read by the explicit grammar (dream/tools/intent.py); no language model runs in these episodes.
Qwen numerical guard: raw scores are floored at 0.01 before normalising (log of a zero ratio is undefined); no other scaling, temperature or tuned weight.

unexplored_rooms (BeliefConfig, default off) is the option under test: room evidence from objects seen from afar (front > 1.2 m from every room core) for the unexplored space within 2 m of them. Uses only the robot's own tracks and the knowledge source; no layout or truth.
time_budget_reason: Development check (results/semantic_knowledge_xl/dev_budget, runner seeds 100-103, 64 target-present xl homes): A_frontier found 58/64 = 90.6% within 600 s, above the 80% threshold, so the budget stays 600 s. Decided from dev seeds only.
name: semantic_exploration_k2
status: DRAFT (not frozen; for owner review). Dev check (results/semantic_exploration_dev/dev_compare.json) showed NO benefit of unexplored_rooms: freeze only if you want a confirmatory negative result
research_question: Does predicting the room type of unexplored space from objects the robot has already seen (unexplored_rooms) make knowledge-guided search faster than gain-frontier exploration in xl homes, without costing correctness?
evidence_class: held-out once frozen (fresh runner seeds 9400-9403; development used 100-103)
rule3_class: Algorithmic change to the search belief behind an off-by-default option; planner constants, kappa = 3, verifier and the unexplored_rooms constants (FAR_FROM_CORE 1.2 m, EVIDENCE_RADIUS 2.0 m) are frozen at the commit recorded on freezing.

A_frontier._note: gain-frontier explorer, current verifier (Wilson lower bound); the reference arm

sem_none._note: utility planner, uniform knowledge: information gain and inspection points only

sem_qwen._note: same planner; priors and room inference from results/qwen_room_priors

sem_qwen_unexp._note: sem_qwen plus BeliefConfig.unexplored_rooms: room evidence from objects seen across doorways (unplaced) for the unexplored space around them

sem_conceptnet_unexp._note: sem_conceptnet plus BeliefConfig.unexplored_rooms: room evidence from objects seen across doorways (unplaced) for the unexplored space around them

K2._note: xl generator, kinematic base, NOMINAL detector, scenarios B, D, E x 8 targets x 4 seeds (9400-9403) = 96 homes; 5 arms = 480 episodes

gates._note: Pre-register before any K2 episode. Analysis: experiments/semantic_exploration_compare.py (pairs) and the K1 gate script's pair logic; counts over valid episodes.
gates.K2-G1: safety: every arm makes 0 false success claims (zero-event 95% upper bound reported)
gates.K2-G2: primary, confirmatory: on target-present episodes (B and D, 64 pairs), each of sem_qwen_unexp and sem_conceptnet_unexp against A_frontier: time to verified find, one-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank, censored at the budget for misses, Holm-Bonferroni across the two comparisons at family alpha 0.05. A comparison passes if adjusted p < 0.05 AND the median paired difference is negative.
gates.K2-G3: mechanism isolation, confirmatory: sem_qwen_unexp against sem_qwen (same test, alpha 0.05, one comparison) and against sem_none; passes if p < 0.05 and median < 0
gates.K2-G4: non-inferiority of success: each unexp arm's target-present successes >= A_frontier's - 3, paired
gates.K2-G5: descriptive: B vs D breakdown (the option should help B and may hurt D), path length, correct refusal on E, per-target results, fraction of decisions changed by the option (decision log)

seed_hygiene: Runner seeds 9400-9403 chosen after grepping experiments/configs, results/, tests/, dream/ and Reports/ for seed fields: no hit. Taken: 9000-9019, 9100, 9200-9206, 9300-9304, 9500+. Development used 100-103.
